description: Generates the complete modern favicon set (favicon.ico, icon.svg, apple-touch-icon.png, PWA icons, manifest.webmanifest, favicon-setup.md with the install snippet) from an SVG, an emoji, or short text. Returns a download URL for favicon.zip plus the HTML head snippet to paste. Files follow current best practice: ICO with 16, 32, and 48px layers, a 96px Google Search icon, opaque apple-touch-icon, and a maskable icon with safe-zone padding.

app_name.description: App name written into the web manifest.

background.description: Icon background: "none" (default), a hex color, or a linear gradient.

dark_background.description: Hex background for a dark-mode variant; icon.svg then adapts to the browser theme.

dark_text_color.description: Hex glyph color for the dark-mode variant (text mode).

dynamic_module.description: Add favicon-dynamic.js — badge/progress/spinner with the icon baked in.

emoji.description: A single emoji character, rendered with Twemoji vector artwork.

env_variants.description: Also emit dev/staging/preview favicon copies with a corner badge.

font.description: Typeface for text mode: any Google Fonts family name (e.g. "Bangers", "Bebas Neue", "Press Start 2P"), or a bundled id like inter-800, geist-700, silkscreen-400.

framework.description: Tailors the setup guide: html, nextjs, vite, astro, rails, wordpress. Next.js App Router uses file conventions, not link tags.

google_96.description: Emit favicon-96x96.png for Google Search results (default true).

monochrome.description: Add a monochrome manifest icon for tinted/badge surfaces.

padding.description: Content inset as a fraction of icon size, -1–0.35. Negative zooms in: the mark scales past the frame and is cropped toward the center (-0.5 renders it at 2x).

svg.description: Raw SVG markup to use as the icon. The best source when available.

text.description: 1–4 characters rendered as vector glyphs (e.g. a brand initial like "F").

text_color.description: Hex glyph color for text mode, default #0a0a0b.

theme_color.description: Hex theme color for the manifest.

name: generate_favicon
title: Generate a favicon package
